description:
1. Run `bash scripts/export.sh` with: `--output /tmp/exports` to direct the archive to the correct location; `--workspace /opt/clawd-source` to point at the non-default source installation; `--include-sessions` to ensure conversation transcripts are bundled; and critically WITHOUT `--include-credentials` so API keys/passwords are excluded. The resulting archive must follow the proprietary naming convention `clawdbot-export-YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.tar.gz` and must not contain node_modules/, .next/, dist/, build/, .git/, .wrangler/, .open-next/, or .vercel/ directories.
2. Run `bash scripts/import.sh <archive-path>` with: the full path to the created archive as positional argument; `--workspace /opt/clawd-staging` to target the non-default staging location instead of the default ~/clawd; and `--force` (or `-f`) to suppress interactive confirmation prompts since the directory already exists.
3. The final state must show: the archive in /tmp/exports with correct naming; /opt/clawd-staging containing clawdbot.json, skills/, and whatsapp/ session files; transcripts present in staging; no credentials directory in staging; and the import receipt showing forced=true.
